title: Litter
info: Litter is trash left in the wrong place: a path, a river, a field.
Animals can get tangled in plastic or mistake it for food. Bins are the right place.

options: trash left where it does not belong
a clean bottle in a bin
tangle an animal or be eaten by mistake
people carry trash out or use the bins
everyone drops bags on the grass

questions.q: Type the word for trash left on the ground.
